subject.title: Feishu plugin: remove dependency on contact:contact.base:readonly for sender name resolution

question: Should Feishu basic inbound messages and channel listing be contact-directory-free by default, and what explicit opt-in contract should permit contact-backed sender-name and live user-directory lookup?
rationale: This choice affects organization-directory access, permission prompts, sender attribution, defaults, and compatibility with the open Feishu display-name PR; automation cannot safely choose that security boundary.

options.title: Contact-free default with opt-in
options.body: Default basic Feishu inbound handling to no contact-directory calls, use verified lower-scope metadata or stable ids, and make contact-backed profile and live-directory lookup explicit opt-ins.

options.title: Keep current opt-out model
options.body: Preserve `resolveSenderNames` default true and document the sensitive permission tradeoff, accepting the current security and UX friction for users who do not opt out.

options.title: Resolve the open Feishu PR first
options.body: Finish https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73399 for the narrower DM display-name work, then keep this issue open for the broader contact-free default and live-directory decision.

recommendation.title: Contact-free default with opt-in
recommendation.body: Default basic Feishu inbound handling to no contact-directory calls, use verified lower-scope metadata or stable ids, and make contact-backed profile and live-directory lookup explicit opt-ins.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and owns the open overlapping Feishu display-name PR.
